{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Guardian Sword Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Guardian Sword Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= 20 |durability= 17 |comp= {{List| * [[Guardian Sword+]] * [[Guardian Sword++]] }} |sample= |theme= }} '''Guardian Swords''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Guardian Sword|Guardian Swords|Series, BotW, AoC}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{AoC}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 20 |durability = 17 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Sword}} Guardian Swords are [[Weapon]]s sometimes wielded by [[Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II]] and, in [[Master Mode]], [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]], which can be found in "A Minor Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. The Swords can be retrieved when the [[Guardian Scout]]s drop them after being defeated. They also have a chance to appear inside [[Treasure Chest]]s that are spawned by scanning the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Guardian Swords use [[Ancient Technology]] to produce their blue energy blade, though they are not very durable. Due to their composition, Guardian Swords deal additional damage against Guardians. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Guardian Swords also do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. Finally, the [[Magnesis]] Rune is incapable of picking them up. Guardian Swords belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of Weapons used by Guardian Scouts. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_013" |Life = 17 |Power = 20 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 15 |BuyingPrice = 39 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Guardian Sword Inactive Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Model of an inactive Guardian Sword File:BotW Ta'loh Naeg Shrine Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Guardian Scout II fighting with a Guardian Sword File:AoC Terrako Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Terrako with a Guardian Sword File:AoC Guardian Sword Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Guardian Sword ==See Also== {{See Also| * Guardian Gear * Guardian Sword+ * Guardian Sword++ * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Guardian Sword}}
